_provenance: src values: capture = the RSProx capture analysis of 60 recorded sessions (MRobertEvers/oldschool-clientc, branch v3, docs/rsprox-analysis/colosseum/README.md, read 2026-11-25), traces = the seven V2 live traces of 2026-08-25, colosim = the colosim port, wiki = https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Fortis_Colosseum, openscim = OpenScim client/encounters (another simulator), inferred = derived, not observed, VERIFY-INGAME = unconfirmed. Captures and traces win over everything else. Turn order is NPC index order (Frame.finishOrder), not a per-type priority. hitDelay: fixed = hitDelayTicks after launch at every distance; projectile = (max(projectileMin, projectileBase + projectilePerTile * d) + projectileOffset) / 30, d the Chebyshev distance at launch (the shaman's curve is (max(80, 67 + 4d) + 15) / 30, the shockwave's (76 + 8d) / 30). prayerCheck: launch = the prayer up on the attack tick decides (capture section 6); launchAndLand = blocked only when prayed on both ticks. corpseTicks: ticks from the killing hit until the body is deleted, during which it blocks other NPCs. attackAnims = animation ids that are genuine attack launches; defendAnims = block/defend animations played when the NPC is hit (never attacks); empty lists mean unclassified - every animation counts as an attack. Split for the simulation module: core fields at the top of each entry, the Colosseum pack's per behaviour settings in its colosseum block (behavior names the pack behaviour; the jaguar's three claws are the core's rolls, and the javelin's skyExpectedFactor1000 comes from V2's eval.json).
